name: Xeramail
tagline: Xeramail gives you a working temporary email inbox in seconds
description: Xeramail gives you a working temporary email inbox in seconds. No registration, no personal information, no account to create. You get an address, you use it, and it self-destructs. How it works 1. **Generate an address**: random or custom name, pick your domain 2. **Use it anywhere**: sign-ups, free trials, Wi-Fi portals, verifications 3. **Read your mail**: messages arrive in real-time, everything deletes itself Features - **Custom email names**: pick your own name (e.g. `myproject@xeramail.co
